title: Skills catch-up for a late start
caption: A fresh Lv 39 Assassin now sees Heart Gore 1 → 10 as one step with its specialty, instead of one level at a time.

title: Next up names the whole skill jump
caption: At Lv 39 Next up leads with "Catch up: level Heart Gore 1 → 10", one Mark spent for the whole jump, "8 jumps left" and one "inferred" tag.

title: Next up catch-up on a phone
caption: The phone card shows one "inferred" tag, no longer "inferred · inferred", and the same "8 jumps left" as the Skills card.

title: Catch-up after three taps
caption: After three taps on a phone the hero is the fourth jump, "5 jumps left"; "Mark all spent" is a 44 px tap target. Each tap undoes from the toast.

title: Lv 45 join with 180 stones
caption: A Lv 45 join holding 180 Wisdom Stones catches up its skills in 15 taps, one per skill jump.
